description: This is a PHP unit test class for the EmailConfigurationAPI within the OrangeHRM system. It contains tests for retrieving, updating, and deleting email configuration data via the Admin API.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmailConfigurationAPI endpoints related to email configuration management in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, resets database tables, and loads test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the API endpoint for retrieving a single email configuration record.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getOne API test from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the API endpoint for updating an email configuration record.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the update API test from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testUpdateWithEmptyConfiguration
methods.description: Tests the update endpoint when the configuration is empty, ensuring proper handling.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdateWithEmptyConfiguration
methods.description: Provides test cases for updating with empty configuration data.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that delete operation is not implemented and properly throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that the validation rules for the delete operation are not implemented.
